Therefore the mandatory real worker execution (T09), explicit reviewer execution (T10), and automatic review pipeline (T11) are BLOCKED at credential resolution despite exact route selection (opencode-go flash/pro) being proven. The truthful-cleanup invariants (never claim success while registered/on disk; retained=true + warning on persistent failure) were exercised and hold at cleanup completion.

Task-contract tooling note (recorded in T02): the installed task validator rejects the queued ACTIVE_TASK.json because of two keys absent from the repo template/validator (schema_version, allowed_external_test_mutations); execution proceeded on the operator's explicit instruction with this discrepancy recorded; the orchestrator should either extend the validator/template with those keys or regenerate the task without them.
